recommendations.issue: Poor staff attitude and customer service issues due to understaffing, lack of training, and stress
recommendations.action: Implement a mandatory customer service and de-escalation training program for all front-of-house staff, and review scheduling to ensure adequate coverage during peak hours to reduce employee burnout.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved staff morale, more welcoming guest interactions, and a reduction in negative reviews related to rude service.

recommendations.issue: Negative experiences with food quality caused by inconsistent kitchen preparation during peak rush hours
recommendations.action: Standardize recipe cards, institute strict plating checklists, and establish a dedicated expeditor role in the kitchen during peak hours to ensure consistency before dishes leave the pass.
recommendations.expected_impact: Consistent dish quality across all operating hours, leading to higher customer satisfaction and fewer food-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Long wait times caused by front-of-house and kitchen bottlenecks during busy periods
recommendations.action: Optimize kitchen workflow and re-evaluate staffing levels on weekends and peak periods, introducing a streamlined menu for high-volume shifts to speed up ticket times.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster table turnover, reduced customer wait times, and improved overall throughput during peak dining hours.
